note: Operational-consistency fixtures. Passing them does not establish real-world effectiveness. held_out=true means the topic/wording was NOT used as an example inside any skill file.

cases.input_brief: Topic: glasses make eyes dependent/weaker (common belief among Iraqi parents). My draft hook: 'معلومة مهمة عن النظارات'. 30 s Reel.
cases.expected_behavior: Verdict PROCEED (AAO myth 14, S35). Says in line 1 that the IDEA is strong and the wording is the weakness. Produces 3 finalists with different mechanisms/insights (e.g. myth correction, evidence-led, personal-stakes for parents). Scopes the claim and handles the myopia-control-lens exception.
